notes: Used only by `eval.mjs --scenarios`. This repository has no plain review-pr or BMad skills, but the scenario set needs the review-pr and BMad families, so these five entries are SYNTHETIC: generic descriptions written for the eval (the BMad ones paraphrase the public BMAD-METHOD skills). `scrub` replaces customer-specific strings in the real descriptions before any router, local or hosted, sees them.

entries.name: review-pr
entries.description: Review a pull request (GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab) against the project's rules and report findings by severity, with a verdict and a merge assessment. Plain PR reviews go here; the -laya-classify and -jev-classify variants run only on an explicit request.

entries.name: bmad-code-review
entries.description: Adversarial BMad code review of working-tree changes, a branch or a story, using layered reviewers (blind hunter, edge-case hunter, acceptance auditor). Use when the user asks for a BMad or adversarial code review.

entries.name: bmad-create-prd
entries.description: Create a new product requirements document (PRD) through guided discovery, or edit or validate an existing PRD.

entries.name: bmad-create-story
entries.description: Create the next story file from the epics and the sprint plan, with full context for the developer: acceptance criteria, tasks and dev notes.

entries.name: bmad-dev-story
entries.description: Execute story implementation following a context-filled story spec file: implement the tasks, write the tests, run the validations and mark the story ready for review.
